items.title: 52060_Eddie Barefield oral history interview
items.q: I go out and see Frank Sebastian to make an audition for the Cotton Club. So we went out and made an audition and he liked the band.

ctx.x: What kind of a place was it?

It was just a ballroom. So we come back and I go out and see Frank Sebastian to make an audition for the Cotton Club. So we went out and made an audition and he liked the band. So he told me, he said, 'I like the band. I'd like to bring your -- Lionel had his band in there already. But he said, 'I'd like to bring your band in but I want you to use Lionel on drums.' And I wouldn't take it. I told him, well, I have a drummer, I have a fellow who's been playing with me ever since we got together, Lee Young was my…
So two weeks later he called me and we went out
